source.label: Placed in M96 as the app draws it, where the star's sight line crosses the disc's midplane: 10,456,180 pc (src/objects/m96-layers/source/recipe.json: centre 10,452,014 pc, inclination 51.07 deg, line of nodes 4.57 deg). The galaxy's distance, which places the galaxy and not a star within it: Tully et al. (2023), Cosmicflows-4, ApJ 944, 94; CDS J/ApJ/944/94, table 2 (distances of individual galaxies), PGC 32192: distance modulus 30.096 ± 0.044 mag (https://cdsarc.cds.unistra.fr/viz-bin/cat/J/ApJ/944/94)

controls.label: Color
controls.qualification: Color of a blackbody at the star's temperature; darkening toward the edge from a model atmosphere. The disc itself is unresolved.
controls.notes: The color of a blackbody at the star's published temperature. The darkening toward the edge is the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 4,950 K and log g 0.75 (u1 0.638, u2 0.125): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used. The spin axis's direction on the sky is a display convention.

physical.credit: Groenewegen radius; Tanvir et al. (1999), MNRAS 310, 175, table 3 (ID 1369: 10:46:42.12 +11:52:07.0); SIMBAD holds that position, from 1999MNRAS.310..175T position; cited distance; no measured rotation axis (display convention)
